sources.title: City of Helsinki AI Register
sources.usage: Case mechanism: public disclosure of AI systems and feedback routes.

sources.title: City of Amsterdam Tada values
sources.usage: Case mechanism: inclusion, human scale, control and data not being final.
sources.limitation: Principles are interpreted for local discussion, not imported as law.

sources.title: JTC Punggol Digital District Open Digital Platform
sources.usage: Case mechanism: district platform linking academia, industry and urban operations.
sources.limitation: Platform logic only; no claim of equivalent governance or investment.

sources.title: Barcelona Decidim citizen-participation guide
sources.usage: Case mechanism: public participation with legible stages and accountable outcomes.
sources.limitation: Participation structure only; no copied text or interface.

sources.title: MIT Kendall Square Initiative
sources.usage: Case mechanism: research, commerce, housing and public space as one innovation ecology.
sources.limitation: Urban-mix reference only; site economics and development rights do not transfer.

sources.title: Montreal Declaration for Responsible AI
sources.usage: Case mechanism: autonomy, inclusion and continuing human responsibility.
sources.limitation: Ethical background, not a binding Beijing standard.

sources.title: Forum Virium Smart Kalasatama final report
sources.usage: Case mechanism: resident-company-city-researcher living lab and bounded agile pilots.
sources.limitation: Pilot-governance reference only; no copied assets or promised replication.
